description: Bean qou-prjo convergence-test of #4817+#4818. Tests whether sign(F_K(q)=Σ_{λ⊢3A,ℓ(λ)≥3} y_λ(q)·χ^λ(β_K;q)·Δ_λ) crosses zero as q runs from the combinatorial limit q→1⁺ to the substrate q₀ (EXPERIMENTAL PROTON ANCHOR). Δ_λ=(−1)^{n(λ)}·dim (PROVED value-only); y_λ via live schur_principal_mpmath (proton anchor, NOT muon cache); χ^λ via q-running color-weighted nuclide braid + f64 Hoefsmit seminormal. Layer-pure (both y_λ and χ^λ at the same q). 0 free parameters; AME not used. Char-free companion G(q)=Σ y_λ·Δ_λ isolates the y_λ weighting. Scope-(a)/(b) per verdict.

parameters.chi_precision: f64 Hoefsmit seminormal (no mpfr kernel in sandbox)

caveats: χ^λ(β_K;q) is f64-precision (pure-Python Hoefsmit seminormal; the mpfr Rust kernel is unavailable in this sandbox — disk quota, documented). y_λ(q) is full 50-dps mpmath. The product is therefore f64-precision — DECISIVE for a SIGN question away from a crossing (|F|=O(1)); near any crossing the located q carries only f64 resolution.

⁴He (n=12) is a documented SANDBOX COMPUTE LIMIT, not a proof gap: the pure-Python f64 Hoefsmit seminormal build for ~60 ℓ≥3 partitions of 12 (dim in the thousands, GB-scale f64 matrices) exceeds >4 min/grid point with no mpfr Rust kernel available (disk quota). The character-free companion G(q) for n=12 IS computed (pure mpmath). Re-run with QOU_INCLUDE_4HE=1 on a host with pyhecke_native to fill in the full character object. n=6 (D) and n=9 (T,³He) fully answer the light-chain crossing question.

SERIALIZATION SPLIT (raw-float64 ratchet). Every numeric field is a decimal string, at the precision of its NARROWEST input. The PRIMARY block passes through the f64 χ kernel and is written at that kernel's round-trip width (17 significant digits) — the same digits the previous raw-float64 output carried, neither inflated nor lost. The COMPANION block is character-free and therefore full 50-dps mpmath, and now shows all of it where float64 was discarding ~34 digits. Note the two are NOT interchangeable: representational width is not accuracy, and the χ path's accuracy is the ~1.5e-6 recorded in chi_vs_witness_max_rel_at_q0, far looser than 17 digits.

value_only object: F_K is NOT a binding energy (Δ_λ is value-only; the extensive super-pairwise magnitude term is open). This probe tests ONLY the SIGN of the ≥3-row trace weighting, not the magnitude.
q0AnchorReason: recovered by transcription from this witness's own payload (key(s): parameters.q0_experimental_proton_anchor). No producer was re-run and no number changed; the pin was always recorded, under a non-canonical key.
